grade.summary: The submission gives a complete and correct proof. The lexicographic monovariant consisting of the valuation-square sum and the number of entries greater than 1 proves finite termination, while the primewise gcd of all valuation coordinates is invariant and uniquely reconstructs the terminal integer.
strengths: Correctly computes the valuation transformation as (min(e,f), |e-f|).
Shows that the square-sum strictly decreases whenever the selected integers have a nontrivial gcd, while the count of entries greater than 1 decreases in the coprime case.
Establishes that at least one entry greater than 1 is always retained, so a terminal board has exactly one such entry.
Correctly proves invariance of the gcd of the valuation coordinates and uses it to give an explicit choice-independent formula for M.
